meta.title: Doné — gift lists & celebration websites
meta.description: Gift lists and celebration websites for Mauritian families, at home and abroad.

testMode: Test mode — no real money is charged.

home.title: The whole family gives, wherever they are.
home.lead: Create a gift list and a celebration website in a minute. Relatives in Mauritius and abroad contribute online — a digital envelope, a honeymoon in Rodrigues, a new sofa — and you receive everything in one place.

envelope.title: The digital envelope
envelope.body: Guests give any amount with a message, just like the lenvlop — and can keep the amount private.

events.title: Every event, one site
events.body: Haldi, mehndi, nikah, church, reception: each event with its date, venue, dress code and RSVP.

abroad.title: Family here and abroad
abroad.body: Lists in rupees, euros or pounds, so relatives in Port-Louis, Paris or London can give easily.

fees.title: Clear, fair fees
fees.body: Free to create. A small service fee is shown at checkout — or you can choose to cover it for your guests.
